summary: Depotauszug-Analyse tested end-to-end. Backend: 8/8 pytest pass (401 unauth, 403 non-admin, 422 for short/empty text, file without media_type, invalid base64, invalid media_type; real text analysis returns correct holder/date/total 27000/4 positions/allocation ~100%). Frontend (desktop 1920): admin login -> sidebar 'Depotauszug-Analyse' under Vermögen & Depot -> /admin/depot-statement-analysis; empty-input error shown correctly; pasted text -> loading state ('Wird ausgewertet …', button disabled) -> result with Depotinhaber, Stichtag, Gesamtwert, Zusammenfassung + observations, allocation bars, positions table. Mobile 390: PDF upload shows file chip, hides textarea, analysis succeeds, no page overflow (scrollWidth 390), table scrolls horizontally inside overflow-x-auto (707px in 356px container). Used 3 real LLM calls in total.

ui_bugs.issue: The 'Depotauszug-Analyse' nav item was listed twice (lines 131-132), which showed a duplicate sidebar link and caused a React duplicate-key warning. FIXED by testing agent.

issues: File chip and its remove (X) button have no data-testid (suggest depot-analysis-file-chip / depot-analysis-file-remove-btn)
Positions table rows and allocation rows have no data-testid

action_items: Optional: add data-testids to the file chip, its remove button and the result rows
Optional: large PDFs going through the Cloudflare preview could exceed about 100 s. Consider a timeout/progress note or an async job if users report 502s
critical_code_review_comments: When a file is chosen, the pasted text is silently ignored (the textarea is hidden but its state is kept). This is acceptable, but the user could be told.
The allocation list uses key=row.category. If the LLM returns a category twice, React shows a duplicate-key warning. Use the index as a fallback.
Sorting the allocation by y.percent - x.percent is fine because the backend defaults percent to 0.
The backend validates base64 and the 10 MB limit, removes the temp file in finally, and requires admin. Nothing is persisted. Good.
seed_data_creation: One TEST non-admin user (test_depot_*@example.com) was created by the pytest fixture and deleted in teardown (verified 0 remain).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Login on preview shows a consent/welcome modal: select an option in the 2nd <select> (Besucherrolle), then click 'Akzeptieren'. Admin creds: patron@froehlich-vermoegensberatung.de / 500Euro!. The test file makes 1 real LLM call (test_text_analysis); one analysis takes about 15-20 s.
